observed_fact: Year-on-year comparison of the latest complete week inside GT-CHOC-A-5Y, recomputed on 2026-11-17 from the unchanged export: 'chocolate' 29 in the week of 2026-10-25 against 37 in the week of 2025-10-26 (minus 8 points); mean of the last four complete weeks 32.0 (2026-10-04 to 2026-10-25) against 35.8 (2025-10-05 to 2025-10-26). 'barra de chocolate' 1 against 1; 'chocolate amargo' <1 against 1; 'chocolate ao leite' and 'chocolate sem açúcar' <1 in both weeks (compressed by the normalisation on 'chocolate', rule R4). Identical to SIG-CHOC-018 (review week 2026-11-02) because no newer export exists.
hypothesis: Off-season search interest for the category term in late October 2026 is below the same weeks of 2025 inside the export, by more than the 5-point sampling band for the single week and by about 4 points on the four-week mean; unchanged from SIG-CHOC-018 and not re-tested this week for lack of a new export.
alternative_explanations: Sampling: repeat exports of this view differed by up to 5 points for 'chocolate'; the four-week difference (3.8) is inside that band. Calendar: the week of 2026-10-25 starts on the second round of the 2026 Brazilian general election; Halloween fell inside both weeks. The bare term includes recipes and non-purchase intent. Search habits migrate to apps and assistants over time.
independent_corroboration: None; single export of a single source. Same facts as SIG-CHOC-018 (same file, same hash).

source_name: Economiza Alagoas (SEFAZ/AL): preços de vendas reais por código de barras e estabelecimento (NFC-e)
source_published_at: continuous (sales of the last 7 days as shown by the site at capture time)
universe_and_method: Weekly read of the public consultation page by scripts/capture-economiza-alagoas.py (rules v1, section 3b): seven pilot terms, food category page of each, 21 sequential requests with 5 s pauses, all HTTP 200, SHA-256 of every raw page in the request log; one row per card kept (GTIN, invoice description, 'valor unitário' and 'última venda' as labelled, sale recency, store). Default view of the site is Maceió. Comparison: median of 'valor da última venda' per GTIN across the stores listed in each capture, only for GTIN present in both captures; stores listed per GTIN change between weeks, so the median compares different store sets. Transacted prices and store presence only: not volume, not share, not Alagoas as a whole, not Brazil.
observed_fact: Second weekly NFC-e capture, 2026-11-16T23:55:03Z (first: 2026-11-11T11:03:49Z): 10,335 chocolate rows, 569 EAN, 988 stores, all in Maceió (first capture: 11,195 rows, 581 EAN, 1,021 stores). 497 EAN are present in both captures (84 only in the first, 72 only in the second). Median 'última venda' price per EAN between the two captures: unchanged for 282 of the 497 EAN; within plus or minus 5% for 381 (77%); lower by more than 5% for 56 and higher by more than 5% for 60; median change 0.0%. Among the 89 EAN listed by at least 20 stores in both weeks, 85 are within plus or minus 5% (median change 0.0%); for example EAN 7891000248768 (Kit Kat ao leite 41.5 g) 5.00 to 5.00 at 357 then 346 stores, 78912359 (Baton ao leite 16 g) 2.29 to 2.30 at 322 then 310 stores, 7891000460207 (Prestígio 33 g) 4.00 to 4.00 at 311 then 295 stores. The largest moves are EAN with one to three stores and descriptions that mix unit and multipack under the same barcode, for example 7891008533729 (Baton Duo: 16 g unit and 480 g box) 26.24 to 3.99 and 7891008199024 (Talento 25 g) 4.99 to 58.19.
hypothesis: Transacted shelf prices per EAN in Maceió were stable between 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-16 for the products sold by many stores; the changes outside the 5% band concentrate in EAN listed by few stores, where the median follows which store sold last and whether the invoice line was a unit or a multipack, so they describe the store sample, not a price movement.
alternative_explanations: The store set behind each EAN median differs between weeks (median 4 then 3 stores per EAN), so a change can be store turnover rather than repricing. The site shows sales of the last 7 days and the two captures are 5.5 days apart, so the windows overlap. Pre-Black-Friday (2026-11-27) or Christmas pricing may begin after this window. Some GTIN carry both unit and box lines (description written by each store), which the capture does not separate.
independent_corroboration: None beyond the two captures of the same source; the retail page snapshots of 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-04 are a different region and different retailers (no EAN) and were not repeated this week (no linked browser).
